CHEBI_GRAPH: path/to/chebi_graph_v252.pkl (optional, downloaded from Hugging Face if missing)
ENSEMBLE_DIR: directory holding the ensemble calibration (prediction_thresholds.yaml, <model>_classwise_f1.txt, best_hyperparameters.csv)
ENSEMBLE_CLASSES: file listing the classes the ensemble was calibrated on, one per line
PR_CURVE: precision/recall curve of the ensemble over the decision threshold (optional; enables the precision/recall sliders)

My model.type: chebifier model type (e.g. gat, chemlog, lopster_clingo, c3p, chebi_lookup)
My model.calibration_name: name the calibration files in ENSEMBLE_DIR were written under (defaults to the key of this entry)
My model.description: shown in the model info panel of the web app
